mapper.insert: insert into student (name, no, gender, clazz_id, id_card, is_college,address, phone, degree, graduation_date, create_time,update_time) values (#{name}, #{no}, #{gender}, #{clazzId}, #{idCard}, #{isCollege}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{degree}, #{graduationDate}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update:
update student
name = #{name},
no = #{no},
gender = #{gender},
clazz_id = #{clazzId},
id_card = #{idCard},
is_college = #{isCollege},
address = #{address},
phone = #{phone},
degree = #{degree},
graduation_date = #{graduationDate},
update_time = #{updateTime}
where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select degree as name, count(*) as value from student group by degree

-- 第一部分：clazz表里所有班级（没人的value=0） select c.name as name, count(s.id) as value from clazz c left join student s on c.id = s.clazz_id group by c.name
union all
-- 第二部分：student表里clazz_id在clazz表中找不到的，归为"其他" select '其他' as name, count(*) as value from student s left join clazz c on s.clazz_id = c.id where c.id is null
